<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant monoisotopic peak followed by a series of decreasing peaks roughly 1 Da apart, with the M+1 intensity (~5.6 % of M) matching the expected contribution from several ¹³C atoms—we can definitively conclude that carbon is present. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) at the observed intensities, so only carbon can be identified with certainty.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
